description: New York City CV Pilot EVENT Data One Month Sample is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by United States Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "New York City Department of Transportation (NYCDOT). (2021). New York City CV Pilot EVENT Data. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1522485". This dataset contains a one-month sample of flattened EVENT data records from the New York City (NYC) Connected Vehicle (CV) Pilot that have undergone obfuscation of precise time and location details as well as other vehicle identifiers. The full unflattened event data from NYC CV pilot can be requested from the ITS DataHub Sandbox. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 51 columns, among them eventHeader_parameters_stopBarTolerance, eventHeader_parameters_excessiveCurveSpd, eventHeader_parameters_timeToCrash, eventHeader_parameters_minSpdThreshold, eventHeader_parameters_timeRecordResolution, eventHeader_parameters_timeRecordFollow. The portal shows 2022-01-01 as the last data update. Attribution given: United States Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is See Terms of Use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
